news.titleEn: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia's board opened an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a woman US intelligence suspects of spying for China.
news.conclusionZh: 黄仁勋承认婚外情，英伟达董事会启动独立调查
news.whyEn: Nvidia is the world's most valuable chipmaker and the bellwether of the AI trade; any leadership or export-control fallout would hit global tech stocks already reeling from last week's selloff.
news.whyZh: 英伟达是AI行情风向标，管理层风波或冲击本已动荡的全球科技股
news.detailEn: Huang disclosed the affair in an email to staff, saying he supports the probe, which will be overseen by a committee of independent directors with outside counsel. The woman, Alice Huang, is linked to Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer accused of helping restricted Chinese firms obtain AI chips. The board said it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised, and Huang will keep running the company. Three House Republican committee chairs have asked him to attend a closed-door briefing on November 18.
news.detailZh: 黄仁勋在给员工的邮件中披露此事，并表示支持调查；调查由独立董事组成的委员会在外部律师协助下进行。涉事女子与英伟达客户Megaspeed有关，该公司被指帮助受限制的中国企业获取AI芯片。董事会称目前没有理由认为国家安全或公司机密受损，黄仁勋将继续担任CEO。三位众议院共和党委员会主席已要求他11月18日出席闭门听证。

news.titleEn: Trump says restarting Iran war 'highly unlikely,' warns he could strike
news.conclusionEn: Trump said renewed strikes on Iran are highly unlikely if talks deliver a deal on its nuclear program and reopening the Strait of Hormuz, while keeping military pressure on.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普称若谈判有进展，重启对伊战争可能性很低
news.whyEn: The eight-month war and Hormuz disruption have fueled global inflation and high oil prices; a deal would ease energy costs for importers worldwide.
news.whyZh: 战事与霍尔木兹海峡受阻推高全球通胀和油价，达成协议将缓解能源压力
news.detailEn: Trump's proposed deal centers on Iran committing never to build nuclear weapons and reopening the Strait of Hormuz to shipping. He stressed the US still has three aircraft carriers in the region and has identified 38 Iranian bridges as potential targets. Washington also launched Task Force Iron Gate to block weapons and materials entering Iran by land, alongside its naval blockade of Iranian ports. Earlier ceasefire attempts have collapsed, so markets remain cautious.
news.detailZh: 特朗普提出的协议核心是伊朗承诺永不发展核武器，并重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。他强调美国在该地区仍部署三艘航母，并已锁定38座伊朗桥梁作为潜在打击目标。美方还成立「铁门特遣队」，在海上封锁伊朗港口之外阻断陆路物资和武器输入。此前几次停火都告失败，市场仍保持谨慎。

news.titleEn: Oil Prices Extend Biggest Weekly Drop Since 2020 With Iran Talks in Focus
news.conclusionEn: Brent slipped toward $97 a barrel on Monday, extending a more than 16% weekly plunge — the biggest since April 2020 — on hopes of a US-Iran deal.
news.conclusionZh: 布伦特油价续跌近97美元，上周暴跌超16%
news.whyEn: A sustained oil decline would ease inflation pressure, help airlines and importers, and give central banks more room to cut rates.
news.whyZh: 油价持续回落可缓解通胀，利好航空和进口国，也给央行降息空间
news.detailEn: Brent opened about 64 cents lower near $97.67 while WTI traded around $90.5. Traders are betting that diplomacy will eventually reopen the Strait of Hormuz and restore Middle East supply. Prices remain far above pre-war levels, and repeated breakdowns in past ceasefires keep a risk premium in the market. Any setback in talks could quickly reverse the drop.
news.detailZh: 布伦特原油周一开盘下跌约64美分至97.67美元附近，WTI约90.5美元。交易员押注外交努力最终能重开霍尔木兹海峡、恢复中东供应。不过油价仍远高于战前水平，过去停火屡次破裂也让市场保留风险溢价。一旦谈判受挫，跌势可能迅速逆转。

news.titleEn: Stock futures rise slightly as investors eye AI trade, brace for more data and earnings: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: US stock futures edged up Sunday night and Asian markets rallied, led by Taiwan and Japan, as investors await Tuesday's CPI and key AI earnings.
news.conclusionZh: 美股期货微涨，台股日股大涨，本周关注CPI和AI财报
news.whyEn: After the S&P 500's worst week since June, this week's inflation data and AI results will test whether the selloff was a buying opportunity or the start of a deeper correction.
news.whyZh: 美股刚经历6月以来最差一周，本周数据将检验是抄底机会还是更深回调
news.detailEn: Nasdaq 100 futures rose 0.3% and S&P 500 futures 0.1% after last week's roughly 5.5% Nasdaq slide tied to fears of tighter AI data-center rules under a Democratic Congress. In Asia, Taiwan's benchmark jumped nearly 5% on rebounds in TSMC and Foxconn, while Japan's Nikkei gained over 3%. Retail investors were notable sellers last week, with Thursday marking their biggest single-day selling since the pandemic. CPI comes Tuesday and PPI Friday, with CoreWeave, Cisco and Applied Materials reporting.
news.detailZh: 纳指100期货涨0.3%，标普500期货涨0.1%；上周纳指因担忧民主党掌控国会后收紧AI数据中心监管而下跌约5.5%。亚洲方面，台股在台积电和鸿海反弹带动下大涨近5%，日经指数涨超3%。上周散户大举抛售，周四创疫情以来最大单日卖出。本周二公布CPI、周五公布PPI，CoreWeave、思科和应用材料将发布财报。

news.titleEn: How Democrats will try to end Trump's tariffs
news.conclusionEn: Democrats, newly in control of Congress, plan to move quickly to reassert authority over tariffs, with Canada tariffs as their first target.
news.conclusionZh: 民主党计划上任即挑战特朗普关税，首选加拿大关税
news.whyEn: Rolling back tariffs would affect import costs, supply chains and trading partners like Canada, though Trump's veto limits how far Democrats can go.
news.whyZh: 关税若松动将影响进口成本和供应链，但特朗普否决权限制民主党空间
news.detailEn: Democrats aim to act in their first 100 hours, with Hakeem Jeffries as likely House speaker able to fast-track bills. Senator Ron Wyden, set to chair Senate Finance, has named Canada's tariffs as the first target, and Rep. Jamie Raskin is probing alleged tariff exemptions for donors. Democrats lack a filibuster-proof Senate majority and face a presidential veto, so they may tie tariff limits to must-pass bills. Several court challenges to the tariffs are also still pending.
news.detailZh: 民主党希望在上任头100小时内采取行动，可能出任众议院议长的杰弗里斯可加快法案审议。即将执掌参议院财政委员会的怀登已点名加拿大关税为首要目标，拉斯金则在调查关税豁免是否涉及利益输送。由于民主党在参议院没有突破阻挠议事的多数，又面临总统否决，可能会把关税限制绑进「必须通过」的法案。多起针对关税的诉讼也仍在进行。

news.titleEn: Russian strikes on Ukraine leave hundreds of thousands without electricity
news.conclusionEn: Russian strikes cut power to about 850,000 people in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv regions, days before US-brokered talks in Abu Dhabi.
news.conclusionZh: 俄军空袭致乌克兰约85万人断电，阿布扎比和谈前夕
news.whyEn: Escalating attacks on the grid raise the stakes for the first three-way Russia-Ukraine-US talks since February, scheduled for Tuesday and Wednesday.
news.whyZh: 打击电网升级，令周二周三的美俄乌三方会谈更受关注
news.detailEn: More than 600,000 residents in Dnipropetrovsk and about 250,000 in Kharkiv lost electricity, and energy firm DTEK said repeated attacks are slowing repairs. President Zelenskyy accused Moscow of escalating to pressure Kyiv ahead of the Abu Dhabi talks. The agenda is expected to include security guarantees, an energy ceasefire and a Black Sea truce for food exports. With winter approaching, grid damage is a growing humanitarian and economic risk.
news.detailZh: 第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克州超过60万居民、哈尔科夫州约25万用户断电，能源公司DTEK表示反复空袭拖慢抢修。泽连斯基指责俄方借升级攻击在阿布扎比会谈前向基辅施压。会谈议题预计包括安全保障、能源停火以及保障粮食出口的黑海停火。冬季临近，电网受损带来的人道和经济风险持续上升。

news.titleEn: COP31 to Open in Turkey, With Climate Goals Under Pressure From War and AI
news.conclusionEn: The two-week COP31 climate summit opens Monday in Antalya, Turkey, as war-driven energy fears and surging AI power demand strain climate goals.
news.conclusionZh: COP31气候大会在土耳其开幕，战争与AI用电冲击减排目标
news.whyEn: Outcomes on electrification targets and climate finance will shape energy investment, coal use and funding for developing countries.
news.whyZh: 电气化目标和气候资金谈判结果将影响能源投资和发展中国家融资
news.detailEn: Nearly 200 countries are meeting through November 20 as the Iran war pushes nations to scramble for oil and restart coal plants, while the US has stepped back from climate diplomacy. Turkey's presidency is pushing a goal to electrify more than a third of the global economy by 2035 and a pledge on sustainable AI. African negotiators want a commitment to triple adaptation finance, but budget-strapped rich countries are reluctant. Finance is expected to be the main fault line.
news.detailZh: 近200个国家代表将在此谈判至11月20日；伊朗战争迫使各国抢购石油、重启煤电，美国也已淡出气候外交。东道主土耳其力推到2035年让全球三分之一以上经济实现电气化，并倡议签署可持续AI承诺。非洲谈判方希望写入适应资金增加两倍的承诺，但财政吃紧的发达国家态度消极，资金预计仍是最大分歧。

news.titleEn: In pictures: France protests draw 146,000 as clashes erupt for fourth straight weekend
news.conclusionEn: About 146,000 people protested across France over living costs and public services, with clashes and at least 360 arrests on a fourth straight weekend.
news.conclusionZh: 法国连续第四个周末抗议，约14.6万人上街、360人被捕
news.whyEn: Sustained unrest adds pressure on France's government during tough budget debates, with implications for its deficit plans and bond market.
news.whyZh: 持续动荡给预算谈判中的法国政府加压，影响赤字计划和国债市场
news.detailEn: The Interior Ministry counted 46,000 marchers in Paris, where police used tear gas, while youth unions put national turnout at 250,000. The movement began with high school students and has grown to include university students, trade unions and Yellow Vest activists. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu meets labor and employer groups on Monday to discuss wages and purchasing power. How he balances concessions against deficit targets will be closely watched by investors.
news.detailZh: 内政部统计巴黎有4.6万人游行，警方动用催泪瓦斯；青年工会则称全国参与人数达25万。这场运动由高中生发起，逐渐扩大到大学生、工会和「黄背心」群体。总理勒科尔尼周一将会见劳资代表，讨论工资和购买力问题。他如何在让步与赤字目标之间取得平衡，投资者将密切关注。

businessTips.explanationEn: Key person risk is the danger that a company's value or operations depend heavily on one individual, such as a founder or star executive. If that person leaves, falls ill or becomes embroiled in scandal, strategy, relationships and investor confidence can suffer. Boards manage it with succession plans, deputies, documented processes and sometimes key-person insurance. Investors often discount companies where one name is synonymous with the brand.
businessTips.explanationZh: 关键人物风险是指公司的价值或运营过度依赖某一个人，比如创始人或明星高管。一旦此人离职、生病或卷入丑闻，公司战略、客户关系和投资者信心都可能受损。董事会通常通过接班计划、培养副手、流程文档化，甚至购买关键人物保险来管理这一风险。如果一家公司和某个名字几乎画等号，投资者往往会给出估值折价。
businessTips.exampleEn: Nvidia's board launching an independent probe into CEO Jensen Huang shows why investors watch key person risk at founder-led firms. For a small business, it could mean writing down supplier contacts and passwords so the shop can run if the owner is away for a month.
businessTips.exampleZh: 英伟达董事会对黄仁勋启动独立调查，正说明了投资者为何关注创始人主导企业的关键人物风险。对小生意来说，可以是把供应商联系方式和账号流程写下来，保证老板离开一个月店也能正常运转。

businessTips.explanationEn: The break-even point is the sales volume at which total revenue exactly covers total costs, so you make neither profit nor loss. It is calculated as fixed costs divided by the contribution margin per unit (price minus variable cost). Knowing it tells you how much you must sell before a side project starts paying you. It also shows how price changes or cost cuts shift your risk.
businessTips.explanationZh: 盈亏平衡点是指总收入刚好覆盖总成本、既不赚也不亏时的销量。计算方法是固定成本除以单位边际贡献（售价减去单位变动成本）。知道这个数字，你就清楚副业要卖多少才开始真正赚钱，也能看出调价或降本会如何改变风险。
businessTips.exampleEn: If your candle side business has $600 a month in fixed costs (studio rent, software) and each $30 candle costs $12 to make, you need 600 ÷ 18 ≈ 34 candles a month to break even. Raising the price to $35 cuts that to about 26 candles.
businessTips.exampleZh: 假如你的蜡烛副业每月固定成本600澳元（工作室租金、软件），每支售价30澳元、材料成本12澳元，那么每月需卖出600÷18≈34支才能保本。把售价提到35澳元，保本销量就降到约26支。

businessTips.explanationEn: Headline inflation measures price changes across the whole consumer basket, including volatile food and energy. Core inflation strips those out to show the underlying trend. Central banks pay closer attention to core because it is a better guide to where inflation is heading. Markets can react sharply when either number surprises forecasts.
businessTips.explanationZh: 整体通胀衡量的是整个消费篮子的价格变化，包括波动很大的食品和能源；核心通胀则剔除这两项，反映更本质的价格趋势。央行更看重核心通胀，因为它更能预示通胀的走向。无论哪个数字偏离预期，市场都可能剧烈反应。
businessTips.exampleEn: With oil falling more than 16% last week, the next few months' headline CPI may cool faster than core. If Tuesday's US core CPI stays sticky, the Fed may still hesitate to cut rates even as gasoline gets cheaper.
businessTips.exampleZh: 上周油价暴跌超16%，接下来几个月的整体CPI可能比核心CPI降得更快。如果周二公布的美国核心CPI依然居高不下，即使油价变便宜，美联储也可能仍对降息犹豫不决。
